# Joint differential margin system (`joint_differential_v1`)

*Generated by `joint_differential.py` on 2026-07-31T15:54:14+00:00 (SMOKE run; gate verdict recorded on a scratch registry COPY - the real ledger was NOT touched, and this run never called register/record_evaluation or rendered leaderboards; the --real run is the orchestrator's). Regime A. Incumbent:
`chanreval_structural_calibrated` (pooled margin MAE 10.0860 on the identical
673 games, reproduced per game to 1.8e-15 before comparison).*

## The registered question

The R2 margin program from the coherence study: predicting each scoring channel's DIFFERENTIAL (home minus away) directly - with differential features including the minutes-weighted RAPM lineup-value differential as new information - beats the incumbent margin head on the 673 chanreval test games. The coherence study proved margins are affine in differentials and that differential information is the only route to margin gains; this is the first registered attempt to add some.

Honest expectation, from the registration: the additive RAPM adjustment captured
+0.02 in the oracle bracket; this differential-chain reframing with fitted
per-channel weights tests whether structure unlocks more. A FAIL maps the R2
route's ceiling with current player values.

## READ THIS BEFORE THE POOLED NUMBER: the RAPM values are not walk-forward (audit 4)

`data/rapm/rapm_v0.csv` `net_100` is a **static** player-value table fit by
`build_rapm.py` on seasons **[2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]** (verified from that file's
`TRAIN_SEASONS` at runtime, not from memory). Test season(s) **[2024]**
sit INSIDE that fit window, so on those 229 games each player's value was
estimated partly from the possessions of the very games being predicted.

Audits 1 and 2 prove the minutes-EWMA **weights** are strictly walk-forward.
They say nothing about the **values** those weights multiply - that is what this
audit adds, and it is the load-bearing caveat of the whole run. The season
pattern is the signature:

| test season | in RAPM fit window | delta vs incumbent |
|---|---|---|
| 2024 | YES - contaminated | +0.6786 |
| 2025 | no - clean | +0.2615 |
| 2026 | no - clean | -0.2883 |

Corroborated model-free, straight from the feature: the raw correlation between
`d_rapm` and the realized margin steps down as the fit window recedes -
**2024: +0.582** (in fit window), **2025: +0.331**, **2026: +0.148**.
Genuine player value should decay gently with roster turnover; +0.58 in the
season whose own possessions built the ratings, against +0.15 two seasons out,
is not gentle decay.

The gain is monotone in contamination. The pooled +0.2662
is therefore **inflated** and is reported only because the registration named
this artifact. **The RAPM-clean seasons [2025, 2026] are the honest read:**

| scope (RAPM-clean, n=444) | MAE | delta vs incumbent |
|---|---|---|
| incumbent | 10.6790 | - |
| ablation (reframing only) | 10.6750 | +0.0040 [-0.2245, +0.2211] |
| full challenger | 10.6256 | +0.0535 [-0.2264, +0.3542] |

On clean seasons the challenger gains **+0.0535**,
which **does NOT clear** the
registered min_improvement of 0.1.
Implied var(u) on clean seasons: challenger
46.08 vs incumbent
45.84.

**What this costs the R2 program:** the honest measurement of "does a lineup-value
differential move the margin" is the clean-season number, not the pooled one. The
fix is not to this script - it is a RAPM refit that is walk-forward by season
(values for season s estimated from possessions before s), which does not exist
yet. Until it does, this route cannot be measured on 2024 at all.

## Does the RAPM lineup differential carry the gain? (preregistered ablation)

| variant | pooled MAE | delta vs incumbent | RAPM-clean MAE | RAPM-clean delta |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| incumbent | 10.0860 | - | 10.6790 | - |
| ablation (differential reframing only, no d_rapm) | 10.1035 | -0.0175 [-0.2034, +0.1618] | 10.6750 | +0.0040 |
| full challenger (reframing + d_rapm) | 9.8198 | +0.2662 [+0.0251, +0.4850] | 10.6256 | +0.0535 |

RAPM increment (full minus ablation, paired per game): pooled
**+0.2837** [+0.1000, +0.4652];
RAPM-clean **+0.0495**
[-0.1694, +0.2676].

**The answer: the differential REFRAMING carries nothing** - the ablation, which
is the reframing with every differential feature except `d_rapm`, lands at
-0.0175 pooled and +0.0040 on clean
seasons, i.e. indistinguishable from the incumbent. Whatever moves is the new
player-value information in `d_rapm`, and on clean seasons that is worth
+0.0495, not the pooled
+0.2837. This directly confirms the coherence study's R2 claim that
recombining existing predictions is dead and only new differential information
moves the margin - while showing the new information available today is worth
less than the gate demands.

## Error-variance split (what the coherence study said to watch)

Margin error = 2u; the common shock c never touches the margin and is untouched
here by construction (var(c) stays 81.52).

| quantity | incumbent (study, side-heads) | incumbent margin head | challenger | ablation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| margin error variance | 162.82 | 161.61 | 160.22 | 164.41 |
| implied var(u) | 40.71 | 40.40 | 40.06 | 41.10 |

The challenger BEAT the incumbent margin head's error variance
(and beat the study's
side-head var(u) = 40.71).

**But that win does not survive audit 4.** On the RAPM-clean seasons only, the
challenger's implied var(u) is 46.08 vs
the incumbent's 45.84 - i.e. **WORSE** by 0.24.
The entire pooled var(u) improvement comes from the contaminated 2024 season.
Answering the registration's question directly: **var(u) = 40.71 was
NOT beaten by walk-forward-clean information** - only by contaminated
information. (Clean-season var(u) sits higher than the study's 40.71 for both
models because 2025/2026 are simply higher-variance seasons than the 2024-26
pooled book; the like-for-like comparison is challenger-vs-incumbent within the
same scope, not against the pooled 40.71.) Note the
study's 40.71 comes from the SIDE-head decomposition while the incumbent margin
head's own error variance implies 40.40; the margin head is the
like-for-like comparison.

## Model

- Features per channel (all home-minus-away differentials, all walk-forward):
  chain-ingredient differentials from the committed channel_base_v2 trends
  (own tendency, opponent allowed, conversion for ft/3pt - the paint/np2 chains
  carry no conversion ingredient, so none is invented), rest-day differential
  (master_team dates), RAPM lineup differential (minutes-EWMA alpha
  0.3 weights over strictly-prior played games, most-recent-team
  roster, rapm_v0 net_100, replacement -0.890 for unrated players -
  regime-A clean, no availability system).
- Ridge per channel (standardized, unpenalized intercept), fit on the
  610 eligible 2021-2023 games; lambda per channel from
  evalharness.inner_tuning_splits (3 walk-forward folds inside 2021-2023),
  frozen: {'ft': 30.0, '3pt': 30.0, 'paint': 100.0, 'np2': 300.0} (ablation: {'ft': 30.0, '3pt': 0.01, 'paint': 30.0, 'np2': 300.0}).
- margin = sum of the four predicted channel differentials, then the house
  train-years-only linear calibration on the same 610 games:
  a=0.1153, b=0.9314 (incumbent: a=1.5172, b=0.7786).
- Mean roster size 13.0; mean
  replacement weight share 0.154.

## Audits (all passed before results were read)

- **Incumbent reproduction:** rebuilt chains + committed calibration reproduce
  `predictions_v2.csv` per game to 1.8e-15; pooled 10.0860
  (ledger 10.086); w2 per-channel chain cross-check 7.1e-15.
- **Shift audit (truncate + recompute):** 18 sampled test games,
  every stat at/after each game's date blanked (trends), master_team truncated
  (rest), played rows truncated (RAPM); all 12 differential
  features identical (max|dev| 0.0e+00).
- **RAPM walk-forward audit:** 20 team-strengths recomputed
  by an independent hand-loop from strictly-prior played games; max|dev|
  6.7e-16.
- **Permutation probe:** train channel targets shuffled within season and the
  WHOLE pipeline refit at frozen lambdas (ridges + margin calibration), x30:
  permuted test MAE mean 11.4730 [11.1718,
  12.1189] vs naive 11.4088
  (+0.0643) - the model collapses to no-skill. The real
  model at 9.8198 is beaten by 0/30
  permutations (p=0.0323); the fitted signal is not leakage plumbing.
  Diagnostic variant that recalibrates on TRUE train margins instead of permuted
  ones does not fully collapse (mean 11.3005) -
  that null keeps one honestly-fitted degree of freedom, which is why the
  faithful null is the pass criterion.
- **RAPM value provenance (audit 4):** `net_100` fit on [2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; test
  seasons [2024, 2025, 2026] -> contaminated [2024] (229 games), clean
  [2025, 2026] (444 games). Audits 1-2 clear the
  minutes-EWMA WEIGHTS; this one shows the VALUES they multiply are not
  walk-forward for 2024. Disclosure audit - it does not fail the run (the
  registration names this artifact), it relocates the honest headline to the
  clean seasons.
